name: god-view
description: God View — 让 Agent 在写代码的同时维护项目地图的 VS Code 扩展

scripts.generated-files-check: pnpm run generate && git diff --exit-code -- packages/protocol/src/generated
scripts.release:verify: pnpm run build && node scripts/verify-release.mjs && pnpm audit --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
scripts.release:verify:public: pnpm run build && node scripts/verify-release.mjs --public && pnpm audit --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
scripts.build: pnpm --recursive --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter "./apps/webview" run build && pnpm --filter "./apps/agent-gateway" run build && pnpm --filter "./apps/vscode-extension" run build
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run dependency-boundary-check
